changes.title: Amazon EC2 G7 instances now available in additional regions
changes.detail: Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) G7 instances powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs are now available in Europe (London), Asia Pacific (Mumbai, Sydney) and South America (Sao Paulo) Regions. G7 instances deliver up to 4.6x AI inference performance and up to 2.1 graphics performance compared to G6 instances. G7 instances also deliver faster performance for GPU-accelerated data analytics workloads. changes.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service announces managed cross-Region disaster recovery
changes.detail: Amazon OpenSearch Service now offers managed cross-Region disaster recovery, so you can meet strict availability and business continuity requirements for mission-critical search, AI, and analytics workloads without building or maintaining replication yourself. After you create domains in two Regions, you can pair them with a single API call or a few steps in the AWS Management Console. Managed disaster recovery delivers a recovery point objective (RPO) of under one minute and a recovery time objective (RTO) of under 20 minutes. The secondary domain stays continuously in sync with the primary.

changes.title: AWS Network Firewall launches next-generation firewall policy
changes.detail: Today, AWS announces next-generation firewall (NGFW) policy for AWS Network Firewall, a new policy model that provides security teams with a simpler policy structure and increased rule capacity. AWS Network Firewall is a managed network security service that protects your Amazon VPCs with access control and threat detection. The new policy model strengthens your security posture by layering firewall and IPS protections instead of combining them, which also makes policies easier to manage. changes.title: Amazon GameLift Servers now supports Game Session Placement Insights
changes.detail: Amazon GameLift Servers now offers Game Session Placement Insights, delivering detailed, per-placement diagnostic logs for game session queue routing. Amazon GameLift Servers routes game session placement requests through queues that evaluate multiple fleet locations based on latency and cost factors. This feature is designed for game developers and engineers who need greater transparency into how their game session queues operate. changes.title: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) now supports post-quantum TLS, wildcard indexes, and $unionWith in version 8.0.3
changes.detail: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) 8.0.3 adds hybrid post-quantum key exchange for TLS, wildcard indexes, the $unionWith aggregation stage, and new change stream events. Post-quantum TLS protects data in transit from traffic that is recorded today and decrypted later with a quantum computer. The new MongoDB APIs let you move more MongoDB workloads to Amazon DocumentDB without changing application code. What's new in 8.0.3: Post-quantum TLS: TLS 1.3 connections use hybrid key exchange based on the Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM) when the client supports it.
